notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: [p]Hello from Hurley Piano! We hope you're enjoying everything Musical Meteors has to offer. [/p][p]Our first patch focuses on fixing some minor bugs and making a few improvements to general gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Medium meteors now have a chance of spawning on Level 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Meteor spawn time reduced from [b]2.5 [/b]seconds to [b]2 [/b]seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Level-up notifs now display time added and any unlocked notes.[/p][/*][*][p]Missed notes now flash red on the keyboard UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Levels 2-10 now add [b]20[/b] seconds to the timer, and subsequent levels now add [b]10[/b] seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed bug causing all keys from a previous game to unlock upon missing a note during a new game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed level-up and missed note notifs persisting on-screen when exiting to the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed audio sliders starting at their minimum values but displaying as 100% when starting the game for the first time.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Contact us at our [url="https://hurleypiano.com/contact/"]website [/url]to report any bug fixes or improvements you'd like to see. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing![/p]
